name: Term-Defined subscription (annual, renewable) with proration enabled
what_it_tests: A Term-Defined line with StartProrationPeriod and ItemSubscriptionTerm enters the term-defined proration path, stamps PricingTermCount, and creates an Asset lifecycle (SubscriptionEndDate, renewal automation >=90 days before expiry)
proc_mechanism: Term-Defined proration filter (SellingModelType='TermDefined' AND StartProrationPeriod IsNotNull AND ItemSubscriptionTerm IsNotNull); ProrationTermDefined element -> PricingTermCount; ListOperationTermDefinedPTC
expected_behavior: Term proration computed; PricingTermCount derived (1 annual or fractional); Asset.IsSubscription=true with SubscriptionEndDate=Start+term; renewal auto-created >=90 days prior
test_setup: Subscription software (e.g. Digital Guardian DLP yearly), Term-Defined, ItemSubscriptionTerm=12/36, StartProrationPeriod set, Qty=10

prior_run.actual: Live V21 real records: QLI 0QLWC000003kaUz4AI New TermDefined Cobalt Strike Qty1 -> NetUnitPrice=5900, NetTotalPrice=5900, TotalLineAmount=5900, PricingTermCount=1, SubscriptionTerm=1, PeriodBoundary=Anniversary, Start=2026-06-29 EndDate=2027-06-28 (Start+1yr-1d). Asset 02iWC000008deyfYAA Price=5900 LifecycleStart=2026-06-29 LifecycleEnd=2027-06-28. Sibling TermDefined QLIs 0QLWC000003kiVl4AI/0QLWC000003khWT4AY also PTC=1. NOTE: my fresh fixture line 0QLWC000003klev4AA came out 0/0/null on headless REST place reprice of an un-Started Draft quote (ListPrice=5900 seeded but UnitPrice/PTC unhydrated) - a reprice-path artifact, not a proc defect; the properly-Started/Accepted line proves the oracle.
prior_run.notes: Active proc verified live = Rev_Mgmt_Default_Pricing_Procedure V21 (9QBWC0000000oWH4AY). SC-3420 guarded TermDefined proration writer (TermDefinedProrationFilterLinelevel/ListOperationTermDefinedPTC/ProrationTermDefined; guard SellingModelType=TermDefined AND StartProrationPeriod IsNotNull AND ItemSubscriptionTerm IsNotNull) is present and effective: real New TermDefined lines derive PTC=1 + EndDate + subscription Asset lifecycle.
